novelty_flags.label: Theorems 1–3 / related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: The published AISTATS 2026 paper LinGaoBlanchetGlynn2026COT on direct conditional-OT estimation and convergence rates is a close omitted comparator; add it and distinguish its rate/estimator from the proposed boundary frontier.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 3
novelty_flags.one_line: Its LinGaoBlanchetGlynn2026SmoothCOT comparison names only the paper and a generic joint-dimensional upper rate, without a theorem, equation, or page anchor for the alleged gap.

soundness_flags.label: Definition 4 and Theorems 1–3
soundness_flags.one_line: The alleged observed-data estimator invokes the population Hessian H induced by the unknown inverse operator but never defines a plug-in inverse, positivity event, or regularization, so the displayed statistic is not yet a determinate computable estimator.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 1
soundness_flags.one_line: Eigenvalues of K are not canonically “associated with an outcome wavelet band” when the variable-coefficient elliptic inverse mixes bands; state restricted-subspace bounds or ordered-eigenvalue bounds instead.

soundness_flags.one_line: Over the triangular class no convergence of q_{a,n}, R_n, or the normalized spectrum is assumed, so the fixed-chaos conclusion is undefined; moreover the claimed studentized regular law names no studentizer.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1–4 / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Smoothness s_y and s_z is treated as known for the oracle resolution choice.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 3 / honest_scope

accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The matched frontier is conditional on the stated local model class, not a global minimax claim.

The published article proves conditional asymptotic normality for changing-kernel quadratic U-statistics dominated by a degenerate second-order term.
